content: Aŋelo niŋdi mede yokwambunda hinek tuguk
Kaŋ aŋelo saŋiniŋnit niŋ kunum foloniŋ foune kagut. Adi yadi mulukwaŋdi mumut timiŋgiŋ, eŋ mebi foloŋ kwembeke kudidi gwaiguk, namanda mele undiniŋ, kayoŋyat kudupmebemnit.
Kohoŋdi pepa kuyaniŋ niŋ agaŋ taŋakiyenit kameyakuk. Kayoŋ didimeniŋdi imeŋgwaŋ wapum foloŋ yaliguk eŋ kayoŋ kapmadidi kwetfoloŋ yaliŋa yakuk.
Yali wapumgoŋ kutiguk, laiondi mede tolak nabugoŋ hinek kutiguk. Kutibune muŋkulap 7 togiŋ.
Muŋkulap toŋa mede yobune nadiŋa kudi youlit yoŋa tiluwene kunumneniŋ kutikuti niŋ nu’walaŋkade indiŋ buguk, “Muŋkulap 7-di mede yoŋit u mu youleŋ, hogok namokop tubune halek.”
Kaŋ aŋelo imeŋgwaŋ wapum foloŋ eŋ kwetfoloŋ yaliŋa yakuk, adi kohoŋ didimeniŋ kunum foloŋkade kohodidim tiŋa mede yokwambundaguk.
Bepaŋ hatihatiŋiŋ dapmandapmaŋnit mokit adi nemenemek hogohogok yehitubuminta-dapmaguk adi’walaŋ wou foloŋ tebiŋa indiŋ yokwambundaguk, “Nai kotigoŋ nimaaŋ mu hatak.
Aŋelo kunakunat 7-di baiŋiŋ fedilune mede tobaak, biyagoŋ hinek nai uŋaniŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede hebiniŋ, koom kwanai-meŋiye polofet heki gigit yeniŋguk, wendiniŋ folooŋ hinek mintawaak.”
Kaŋ kunum gineniŋ mede nadigut uŋakoŋ kotigoŋ mintaŋ indiŋ naniŋguk. “Du wooŋ aŋelo imeŋgwaŋ wapum foloŋ eŋ kwetfoloŋ yaliŋa yali pepa taŋakiyenit kameyatak u tibeŋ.”
Unduŋ yobune nu wooŋ aŋelo pepa honeeŋ yakuk u namdok nimbene indiŋ naniŋguk, “Tiŋa na! Naweŋ kaŋ kabakeneŋ buukaaŋ tibek eŋ mageneŋ adi kobaŋiŋ simiŋkupuk nabugoŋ tibek.”
Unduŋ yoŋa agaŋ pepa nambune nagut. Nawene mane gineŋ simiŋkupuk nabugoŋ kobaguk, ala kumuyewene kabatne gineŋ buka tuguk.
Kaŋ indiŋ naniŋgiŋ. “Du meeniŋ bop fee hinek, folonamandaphik eŋ mede waliniŋhik mebimebi, tiŋa mapmehiye aditok kigili mede kotigoŋ yobaaŋ.”
